description: A photograph depicting a greenish-brown body of water, likely a reservoir or dam lake, situated within a rugged, arid, mountainous landscape. A concrete dam wall is visible across the narrowest part of the valley, retaining the water. Rocky, barren slopes rise steeply from the water's edge on both sides. A red dashed line is superimposed over the image, tracing the perimeter of the water body along the shoreline, indicating its delineation for land cover mapping. According to Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) nomenclature guidelines, such dam lakes and barrages are included in the classification category for "Lakes, ponds and pools of natural origin" (category 8.1.1), despite their artificial origin, if they contain fresh water and have a natural structure.
